titulo: The 2009 website with a visitor counter
hooks: Does your website still have a visitor counter?
I checked out my dad's website

mensajes.texto: Dad, I just checked out the shop's website
Isn't it nice? Had it made in 2009
Ok, but the other four are customers

contenido.remate: Some websites have earned their retirement

captions: A visitor counter, music that autoplays and a blinking 'Welcome to our website.' If your site has any of these, it's earned its retirement with full honors.
If the person visiting your website the most is you, something's off. A website that looks good on a phone and shows up on Google brings in people who don't know you yet.
An old website does the job until a new customer opens it on their phone and can't read a thing. From that day on, it's working against you.
